summary: NeOnc Technologies Holdings filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing a registered direct offering priced on September 8, 2026. The company sold 2,610,715 common shares, pre-funded warrants for 960,715 shares, and accompanying warrants for 3,571,430 shares at a combined price of $4.20 per share and warrant, raising approximately $15 million gross. Net proceeds will fund working capital and redeem Series A Convertible Preferred Stock. The offering, made under an April 2026 shelf registration, was expected to close September 10, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. The transaction is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
